longTitle.officialTitle: To repeal certain mandates of the Department of Homeland Security Office of Inspector General.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “DHS OIG Mandates Revision Act of 2014”.

subsection.heading: Repeal of Requirement To Conduct an Annual Evaluation of the Cargo Inspection Targeting System.—

paragraph.heading: Repeal.—
paragraph.content: Subsections (g) and (h) of section 809 of the Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Act of 2004 (Public Law 108-293; 46 U.S.C. 70101 note) are repealed.

paragraph.heading: Conforming amendments.—
paragraph.chapeau: Section 809 of the Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Act of 2004 (Public Law 108-293; 118 Stat. 1085), as amended by paragraph (1), is amended—

subparagraph.content: in subsection (a), by striking “and (j)” and inserting “and (h)”; and
by redesignating subsections (i), (j), and (k) as subsections (g), (h), and (i), respectively.

subsection.heading: Repeal of Requirement To Conduct an Annual Review of Coast Guard Performance.—

paragraph.heading: Repeal.—
paragraph.content: Section 888(f) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 468(f)) is repealed.

paragraph.heading: Conforming amendments.—
paragraph.content: Section 888 of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 468), as amended by paragraph (1), is amended by redesignating subsections (g), (h), and (i) as subsections (f), (g), and (h), respectively.

subsection.heading: Annual Review of Grants to States and High-risk Urban Areas.—

paragraph.heading: Repeal.—
paragraph.content: Section 2022(a)(3) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 612(a)(3)) is repealed.

paragraph.heading: Conforming amendments.—
paragraph.chapeau: Section 2022(a) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 612(a)), as amended by paragraph (1), is amended—

subparagraph.content: by redesignating paragraphs (4), (5), (6), and (7) as paragraphs (3), (4), (5), and (6), respectively;

clause.content: by striking “paragraphs (2) and (3)” and inserting “paragraph (2)”; and

paragraph.heading: Effective date.—
paragraph.content: The amendments made by this subsection shall take effect on January 1, 2015.
